caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a simple, rustic design, featuring four legs and three horizontal slats on the backrest. The chair is rendered in light brown tones, representing the natural color of the wood. The seat is depicted in a muted green color, giving the appearance of a woven or fabric material stretched across the wooden frame at the top of the legs. The chair's legs are cylindrical and connected by horizontal wooden supports. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color with no additional objects or decorative elements. The artist's name, "Virgil Biseto," appears in small text at the bottom right corner.
title: Rawhide Bottom Chair
